description: Pure decision function that enumerates every reason a repair trace produced by the current campaign is NOT admissible as a training corpus row. Distinguishes *evidence* (signed, indexed, replayable — under assurance/evidence/) from *training data* (would feed model fine-tuning — under corpus/). At this rung every trace is BLOCKED, with at minimum BLOCKED_MOCKED_MODEL_OUTPUT + BLOCKED_TEMP_WORKSPACE_ONLY + BLOCKED_NO_LIVE_MODEL_CALL + BLOCKED_POLICY firing. Future rungs (live model admission, live operator approval) may defeat individual reasons; only when every reason is satisfied can a positive admission step open eligibility.
purpose: Rung 7 of the verified-repair campaign. The boundary between 'we ran this' and 'this teaches the model.' Pins the policy that no evidence produced under mocked / fixture conditions ever flows into training. Sets up LOCAL_MODEL_ADMISSION_POLICY (next rung) to start defeating the NO_LIVE_MODEL_CALL reason.

blocked_reasons.MOCKED_MODEL_OUTPUT: Every trace today routes through MockModelClient. Mocked output is evidence, not training data.
blocked_reasons.TEMP_WORKSPACE_ONLY: Patches only ever applied to a SafePatchWorkspace temp copy. Temp-only patches are evidence, not training data.
blocked_reasons.SOURCE_NOT_APPROVED: No accepted ApprovalGateDecision was supplied with the trace.
blocked_reasons.VERIFIER_FAILED: The trace's safe-patch verifier returned PATCH_VERIFIER_FAILED.
blocked_reasons.NO_LIVE_MODEL_CALL: The current campaign uses mocked model output exclusively.
blocked_reasons.HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: No approval has been generated yet (approval is None or REQUIRED).
blocked_reasons.POLICY: Default policy blocks corpus admission for every trace produced by the current campaign.

invariants: RepairTraceEligibilityGuard.evaluate is a pure function — no I/O.
Every trace under DEFAULT_POLICY decides BLOCKED, regardless of pass/fail/unsupported.
training_eligible is False on every CorpusEligibilityDecision, even under a hypothetical all-flags-open policy (eligibility requires a separate positive admission step).
BLOCKED_MOCKED_MODEL_OUTPUT, BLOCKED_TEMP_WORKSPACE_ONLY, BLOCKED_NO_LIVE_MODEL_CALL, and BLOCKED_POLICY fire for every trace under DEFAULT_POLICY.
BLOCKED_UNSUPPORTED_REPO fires only when trace.final_status == TRACE_BLOCKED_UNSUPPORTED_REPO.
BLOCKED_VERIFIER_FAILED fires only when trace.safe_patch_result.verifier_status == PATCH_VERIFIER_FAILED.
BLOCKED_SOURCE_NOT_APPROVED clears when an ACCEPTED ApprovalGateDecision is supplied; remaining reasons still apply.
BLOCKED_HUMAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED clears once an approval has been produced (accepted or blocked); REQUIRED still fires while no packet has been submitted.
scripts/corpus/repair_trace_eligibility_*.py contains no `import subprocess`, no `import urllib`, no `import socket`, no `import http`.
Guard evaluation does not mutate the original workspace tree (sha256 before==after).
Audit counts: BLOCKED_UNSAFE=0, MUST_MIGRATE=0, UNKNOWN=0, PROGRAMBENCH>=56.
remaining_gaps: Even with a hypothetical all-flags-open policy the guard emits CORPUS_ELIGIBILITY_EVIDENCE_ONLY rather than ELIGIBLE — eligibility requires a future rung's *positive* admission step (not just absence of blockers).
BLOCKED_NO_LIVE_MODEL_CALL and BLOCKED_MOCKED_MODEL_OUTPUT are conceptually similar but separate flags so a future LOCAL_MODEL_ADMISSION rung can satisfy them independently.
